ciEnforceableReason: NOT CI-ENFORCEABLE. The source data lives in .peaks/_runtime/<sessionId>/metrics/slices.jsonl, and every such path is gitignored — a CI runner has no session data, so there is nothing there to compare against. This file is a local review artifact: regenerate it with `peaks observability baseline --write` on a machine that has session data and compare it with `peaks observability baseline --check` during a local run or a slice review.

tolerance.note: Absolute drift allowed per row kind when `peaks observability baseline --check` compares the tracked artifact with the freshly computed baseline.

baselineRows.unit: slices at or over the cap / slices
baselineRows.description: Share of slices at or over the RD/QA repair cap. Version 2 metric.
Highest repair-cycle count held by a single slice. Version 2 metric.
Highest number of QA phases in one slice. A QA phase is NOT a repair cycle.
Share of slices whose final state is a terminal happy state.
Share of slices whose final state is blocked.
Mean sub-agent dispatch cost per slice.

populationDescriptors.note: Population descriptors, NOT baseline rows: these grow with the number of slices ever recorded and must never be gated on. The baseline rows above are rates and peaks.

metricComparison.note: Version 1 counted qa-role slice-transition events (QA's own internal state transitions, doubled by the duplicate emission) and was never a repair-cycle count. Version 2 counts repair cycles. The historical numbers below are a different measurement, not a regression — do not compare a v1 number with a v2 number.
